change.title: Phase 5: Component-checked retail launches and professional CAD
change.reason: Revised after author feedback: CP/M Migration launches at NCC 1980; Business Accounts, Developer Workstation, Connect My Office and Connected Office at NCC 1981; Development Team at COMDEX 1981; Office Professional at NCC 1982; and both AutoCAD packages remain at COMDEX 1982. Office Professional cannot launch unchanged at COMDEX 1980: its BOM includes the later network card, AIONix Server cartridge and mouse. Correct Business Accounts to the existing native BPI AIONix edition. Clarify that CP/M client media included in the Connected Office and Development Team multi-platform software packages is for separately supplied qualified Aurelia hosts, not for execution on the bundled Artemis machines. Preserve the seven earlier packages as later COMDEX 1982 demonstrations and remove only the two CAD packages from the campaign reverse-launch list. Event dates, ownership, quantities, pinned versions and canonical technical definitions remain unchanged. These are proposed public introductions, not proof of qualification or shipment. The eight already-authorized phase 5 groups and all other deferred gaps remain unchanged. Per-product evidence: data_storytelling/review_evidence/catalogue-phase5/feedback-amendment.json.

message: headline: A clear view of your next design.
subheadline: Autodesk AutoCAD on Logix Artemis PRO. From drawing to plotted output.
messages / 0 / message: See the drawing clearly
messages / 0 / proof: Native 800x600 drawing area on the 17-inch screen, four shades selected from 16 levels, static CAD palette and demonstrated line quality.
messages / 1 / message: Keep commands and drawing in view
messages / 1 / proof: Colour command/status display alongside the dedicated drawing screen, with explicit keyboard/mouse focus.
messages / 2 / message: Take the drawing beyond the screen
messages / 2 / proof: Save, reopen, exchange and plot the same test drawing; verify coordinates and output scale.
messages / 3 / message: Buy an application with a supported platform
messages / 3 / proof: Autodesk application support and Logix hardware/integration support, qualified configurations, dealer training and a clear upgrade route.
call to action: Bring a drawing. See it on Artemis. Take home the plot.
claim_policy: claim limits / 0: Do not promise 16 simultaneous shades at 800x600x2bpp.
claim limits / 1: Advertise 60 Hz only after the selected HD17H derivative is qualified.
claim limits / 2: No claim that a binary TTL/ECL amplifier becomes grayscale solely through a digital controller.
Present the release-quality Artemis build at COMDEX; commercial shipment remains conditional on acceptance and agreed Autodesk terms.

stage.label: Stage 1
stage.description: Open a representative mechanical or floor-plan drawing from disk; show the command screen and drawing screen together.

stage.label: Stage 2
stage.description: Create and edit supported lines/arcs using typed coordinates and mouse input. Use only commands present in the qualified AutoCAD 1.0 build.

stage.label: Stage 3
stage.description: Pan/zoom and compare ordinary versus antialiased line rendering at the same scale. State measured redraw behaviour; do not promise arbitrary real-time performance.

stage.label: Stage 4
stage.description: Save and reopen the drawing, demonstrate tested exchange, and show the resulting plot.

stage.label: Stage 5
stage.description: Explain complete-system and existing-owner upgrade routes, support ownership, and book an evaluation.

stage.label: hero demo / plotter timing
stage.description: Run a small live plot; disclose any larger pre-plotted sample as such. Do not imply a long plot completes within a short demonstration.

stage.label: hero demo / proof policy
stage.description: Use a fixed published test drawing and configuration. Distinguish line-rendering smoothness from numerical geometry accuracy; no unsupported competitor speed comparison.

marketing_content.description: Live drawing theatre
Repeat the 12-minute workflow at scheduled times with Autodesk and Logix presenters.
Hands-on design desks
Supervised trials using supplied or screened customer drawings; gather task-specific feedback.
Dealer and customer consultation
Qualified configuration, training, storage/plotter needs and documented configuration.
Developer partnership desk
Explain the Autodesk collaboration and Team Edition development workflow; keep this secondary to CAD.
Joint Logix/Autodesk announcement and named support responsibilities
Accurate 128 KiB/four-shade/17-inch specification and compatibility table
Sample drawing, photograph of the actual display and plotted output
Measured configuration-specific results with reproducible test procedure
Availability, acceptance status and separate hardware/software scope
Offer a booked drawing evaluation and documented configuration.
Publish the existing-owner upgrade route alongside the complete reference system.
Make introductory training scope explicit and confirm delivery arrangements before promising inclusion.
Maintain Autodesk branding and non-exclusive licensing; include AutoCAD only under an agreed licence and package scope.

before.title: COMDEX 1982 — Logix professional graphics and Autodesk AutoCAD
before.description: Logix and Autodesk jointly present AutoCAD for Artemis with the professional dual-display configuration. Demonstrate the same drawing from entry through saving and reopening to plotted output, offer supervised trials and book dealer evaluations. Present the November professional graphics upgrade and explain the support and delivery arrangements. Commercial shipment remains conditional on acceptance.

inputs.description: The release-quality Artemis/AIONix build supplies the demonstrated drawing workflow; commercial shipment still depends on acceptance.
The drawing demonstration requires the professional dual-display hardware, mouse and operating-system environment, rather than the development tools used to build the application.

outcomes.description: Joint drawing-workflow demonstrations, supervised trials and booked dealer evaluations support the professional offering launch.
